title: Computed Permutation Trellis Coding: Near-Optimal Quantization from Two Multiplications and a 64-Byte Table
abstract: arXiv:2611.22019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose Computed Permutation Trellis Coding (CPTC), a low-bit quantization format for tensors written once and read many times. Formats that round each value on its own, such as INT4 and FP4, waste a large part of their bits against the information-theoretic ideal. Trellis codes recover this loss by encoding values jointly, but prior decoders either need a large lookup table for their best quality or compute values with a hash that restricts what they can decode. CPTC's decoder multiplies its state by two coefficients and adds the top bits of the products to index a 64-byte table. Because that sum is not uniformly distributed, the rarely used ends of a small table can hold values far out in the tails. One decoder serves every bit width from 1 to 6, reproduces the standard integer and floating-point formats exactly, and comes within 0.07 bits of the ideal at 4 bits. It matches a random-permutation trellis code whose table is thousand

translated_title: 计算置换网格编码：基于两次乘法和一个64字节表的近最优量化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了计算置换网格编码（CPTC），这是一种针对“一次写入、多次读取”张量的低位宽量化格式。诸如INT4和FP4这类对每个值独立进行舍入的格式，相对于信息论理想而言浪费了大量比特。网格编码通过对多个值进行联合编码来挽回这一损失，但现有的解码器要么需要大型查找表才能达到最佳质量，要么使用哈希来计算值，从而限制了其可解码的范围。CPTC的解码器将其状态乘以两个系数，并将两个乘积的高位比特相加以索引一个64字节的表。由于该和并非均匀分布，小表中很少被使用的边缘位置可以存放分布尾部很远的值。一个解码器即可覆盖从1到6的所有位宽，能精确复现标准的整数和浮点格式，并在4比特时距理想值仅差0.07比特。它的性能可以与表规模大数千倍的随机置换网格编码相媲美。
tldr: 提出CPTC量化格式，其解码器仅需两次乘法和一个64字节表即可实现近最优的低位宽张量量化，在4比特时距信息论理想仅差0.07比特，同时支持1至6比特所有位宽并精确复现标准整数与浮点格式。
en_tdlr: Computed Permutation Trellis Coding (CPTC) achieves near-optimal low-bit tensor quantization with a decoder requiring only two multiplications and a 64-byte table, coming within 0.07 bits of the information-theoretic ideal at 4-bit width while supporting all widths from 1 to 6 bits and exactly reproducing standard integer and floating-point formats.
